primary.note: Identical in light and dark so the brand note never shifts between themes. Also bound to --ring. Carries a near-black label (--primary-foreground, 6.06:1); a near-white label on this fill measures 3.13:1 and fails AA. When blue is type rather than a fill, use --primary-text instead.

primary-text.note: Signal Blue used as type. The only role in the system that varies by theme: light oklch(0.52 0.154 252) = 5.54:1 on page; dark oklch(0.7 0.162 252) = 6.16:1 on card. Same hue as --primary, not a second accent.

background.note: Dark mode is a layered grey, not black: sidebar 0.18 under background 0.205 under card 0.24.

foreground.note: Source of every translucent hairline via ring-foreground/10. Dark mode lifts to oklch(0.92 0 0).

muted.note: --muted, --secondary and --accent deliberately share this value. They are semantic aliases, not three greys; change them together.

muted-foreground.note: Secondary copy, chip blurbs, captions. Dark mode lifts to oklch(0.68 0 0).

border.note: Decorative boundaries only. Form-control edges use --input, one step darker (oklch(0.8 0 0)) so a field reads against a white page. Dark mode switches both to alpha-white: --border oklch(1 0 0 / 7%), --input oklch(1 0 0 / 10%), so hairlines stay even against every layer.

destructive.note: Never a solid fill on actions — used as a 10% tint with destructive-colored text. Lightens to oklch(0.68 0.18 22.216) in dark mode. Also the usage-meter fill past 90% of cap.

chart-1.note: Data-series only, consumed as bare var(--chart-1). The dark-mode ramp is re-authored entirely rather than lightness-shifted: oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376).

trend-up.note: Tailwind emerald-600 (emerald-400 in dark) on KPI delta indicators. A semantic content color inside generated cards, not chrome — the one sanctioned exception to the One Signal Rule. Paired with rose-600/rose-400 for down and Half-tone for flat.

display.purpose: The empty-state headline only — the first sentence a cold visitor reads.

headline.purpose: Heading level 1 inside generated cards. The largest type the model can emit.

title.purpose: Card titles and Heading levels 2–4. Card titles use --font-heading at weight 500.

body.purpose: The system default: messages, card text, list items. Form labels take weight 500.

label.purpose: Chip blurbs, captions, meter readouts, helper and error text. Numeric readouts add tabular-nums.

mono.purpose: Reserved for the uppercase eyebrow on the crawler-facing root page. The only monospaced texture in the system.

shadows.name: card-ring
shadows.purpose: The default boundary for every card surface (ring-1 ring-foreground/10). A ring, not a border, so it stays out of layout.

shadows.name: chip-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: The only hover shadow in the system. Chip cards raise it because they stand in for generated content; chrome never does.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: 3px Signal Blue bloom on focus-visible, paired with border-color: var(--ring). Deliberately thicker than the platform default — a 1px outline disappears at 32px control height.

motion.name: card-entrance
motion.value: gsap.from({ opacity: 0, y: 12, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out', clearProps: 'opacity,transform' })
motion.purpose: The generated card's container fade-and-rise. Uses from() so the resting DOM state is the visible one — if JS never runs, the card still shows.

motion.name: card-stagger
motion.value: gsap.from(children, { opacity: 0, y: 8, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out', delay: 0.08, stagger: { amount: 0.35 } })
motion.purpose: The card's content children cascade in behind the container. Targets the direct children of card-content, or of the root element for non-card specs.

motion.name: reduced-motion-gate
motion.purpose: Every entrance animation sits inside this gate. Non-negotiable for new motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, focus and disabled state changes on controls.

motion.name: active-press
motion.purpose: The tactile nudge on button :active. What makes 32px controls read as deliberate rather than cramped.

motion.name: chart-entrance
motion.purpose: Deliberately none. Recharts' draw-on animation would be a second entrance competing inside the GSAP cascade, it is not reduced-motion gated, and at frame zero a line renders as an empty plot wherever requestAnimationFrame is throttled.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Signal Blue fill, 32px tall, 3px focus bloom, 1px active press.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action and the sidebar's New chat control. Hairline border, hovers to Whisper.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-outline"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>New chat</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border-color: var(--border); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-outline svg { flex-shrink: 0; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: The workhorse for icon actions — sidebar triggers, row menus, stop. No fill until hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-ghost ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Open sidebar"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="4" x2="20" y1="6" y2="6"/><line x1="4" x2="20" y1="12" y2="12"/><line x1="4" x2="20" y1="18" y2="18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-icon { width: 32px; padding: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 32px field, transparent over a hairline. 16px text on mobile stepping to 14px at md to prevent iOS zoom-on-focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; outline: none; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { font-size: 14px; } } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Starter Chip Card
components.description: Signature. The anonymous visitor's entire input vocabulary — a 2x2 deck of icon cards. The only element that raises a hover shadow.
components.css: .ds-chip-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; text-align: left; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-chip-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 20%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-chip-card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring), 0 0 0 4px var(--background); } .ds-chip-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-chip-card:hover .ds-chip-icon { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-chip-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip-label { font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-chip-blurb { font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: 20px pill for metadata inside generated cards. Four catalog tones map to four variants.
components.html: Shipped Pending Over cap
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 26px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-default { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-badge-outline { border-color: var(--border); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-badge-destructive { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; } .ds-kpi { gap: 4px; padding: 16px; height: 100%; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-kpi-delta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-kpi-delta-up { color: oklch(0.596 0.145 163.225); }

components.name: Usage Meter
components.description: Signature. A 4px track showing the daily budget as it is spent; the fill flips to Alarm past 90%. The only place in the chrome where a constraint is drawn rather than written.
components.html: 62% left
components.css: .ds-meter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-meter-track { width: 64px; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--muted); } .ds-meter-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--primary); transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-meter-fill[data-warn="true"] { background: var(--destructive); } .ds-meter-readout { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: User Message Bubble
components.description: The user's turn: a right-aligned Whisper bubble capped at 95% width. The assistant's turn is bare text on the page — no bubble, no avatar.
components.html: Plot some data in a graph.
components.css: .ds-msg-row { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-msg-user { max-width: 95%; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: 10px; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is unlit stagecraft. Every chrome decision — the zero-chroma neutrals, the hairline rings, the 32px controls, the single accent used sparingly — exists to keep the eye off the frame and on the one thing that just appeared under the light: a card the model composed a moment ago. When a generated card fades and rises into the transcript, it should be the only event on screen.

The consequence is an inversion of the usual chat aesthetic. The shell does not compete; it does not brand itself in gradients or glass; it does not announce that an AI lives here. It is a well-built, compact, unremarkable room, and the remarkable thing is what gets rendered into it. Density is tight throughout — controls stand 32px tall, body copy sits at 14px, the sidebar is a fixed 288px column — because a stage that wastes space steals attention from the performance.

The voice is warm and approachable, but never playful. Warmth comes from plain-spoken copy, generous breathing room around the content column, and motion that has a pulse — not from oversized radii, mascots, bouncy easing, or emoji-led empty states. The corner-radius ceiling (10px base, 26px only for pills) and power2.out easing are the limit of softness in this system.
keyCharacteristics: One chromatic accent — Signal Blue — on an otherwise neutral field
Flat chrome, hairline rings; depth reserved as a signal for generated content
Compact 32px control height with tactile feedback (3px focus ring, 1px active nudge)
A single centered 768px column for reading and input, at every breakpoint
Geist Sans and Geist Mono, no third family
One deliberate motion moment: the generated-card entrance, reduced-motion gated

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only chromatic color permitted in the chrome. If a second hue seems necessary, the answer is a neutral at a different lightness or the existing destructive token — not a new accent. --primary-text is the same hue at a different lightness, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Fill-Or-Text Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue as a fill is --primary and carries a dark label. Signal Blue as text is --primary-text. Using --primary as a text color is the one way to reintroduce the contrast failure this system was corrected for.

rules.name: The Chart Palette Is Not The Brand Rule
rules.body: --chart-1 … --chart-5 are data-series colors and appear only inside charts. They never fill a button, a badge, a border, or a background.

rules.name: The Neutrals Are Aliases Rule
rules.body: --muted, --secondary, and --accent intentionally resolve to one value. Change them together or change the semantics, never one in isolation.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Sans and Geist Mono. No third family, no serif, no display face. Hierarchy is carried by weight, size, and tracking.

rules.name: The Small-Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy is 14px. 16px and above belong to card titles and headings only; dropping body to 12px is reserved for the label tier, never for prose.

rules.name: The Single Measure Rule
rules.body: Every reading and input surface centers on the same 768px column. A new surface that introduces a second content width breaks the shell's spine.

rules.name: The Flat-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome is flat at rest. If a chrome element needs separation, it gets a hairline ring or a tonal step — never a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Lift-Means-Generated Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a signal reserved for model-produced content and the surfaces that stand in for it. Do not spend it on navigation, toolbars, or dialogs.

rules.name: The Ramp-Only Rule
rules.body: Every corner value comes from the --radius ramp. A hard-coded border-radius is a defect, not a variation.

rules.name: The Pill Is For Metadata Rule
rules.body: Fully rounded shapes mark small, non-interactive status objects — badges, receipts, meters. Actions are 10px; surfaces are 14px.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue (oklch(0.65 0.196 252)) as the only chromatic color in the chrome, and keep the fill identical across light and dark.
Do reach for --primary-text whenever blue is type and --primary whenever blue is a surface, and check any new foreground/background pair against 4.5:1 before shipping it.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px foreground/10 ring or a tonal step, never a shadow.
Do pull every corner value from the --radius ramp (6 / 8 / 10 / 14 / 18 / 22 / 26px): 10px for controls, 14px for surfaces, 26px for pills.
Do hold controls to 32px with 14px labels, and give every interactive element the 3px ring-ring/50 focus bloom.
Do center every reading and input surface on the 768px column.
Do gate every entrance animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and author it with gsap.from() so the resting DOM state stays visible without JavaScript.
Do carry warmth through plain copy, breathing room, and live motion — and, when the approved warm-neutral shift lands, through a low-chroma warm hue applied to the whole neutral ramp at once.
Do reserve --chart-1 … --chart-5 for data series inside charts.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a serif, or a third font family.
Don't put a white or near-white label on Signal Blue, and don't set body text in --primary; both are the 3.1:1 pairings this system was corrected away from.
Don't add drop shadows to chrome — navigation, toolbars, dialogs, or the composer.
Don't exceed the radius ramp or hard-code a border-radius; oversized rounding reads as the playful register this system rejects.
Don't use bouncy or elastic easing, mascots, or emoji-led empty states.
Don't fill a destructive action with solid red; use the 10% tint with destructive text.
Don't change --muted, --secondary, or --accent in isolation — they are aliases of one value.
Don't let chrome out-weigh a generated card. If a new surface competes with the card for attention, the surface is wrong.
